description: This file declares functions related to handling object IDs in a version control context, including parsing arbitrary hex strings into object IDs and setting up hash algorithms based on environment variables.

methods.name: cl_parse_any_oid
methods.description: Parses a hex string and converts it into an object_id structure, supporting different hash algorithms depending on configuration.

methods.name: cl_setup_hash_algo
methods.description: Initializes the hash algorithm based on an environment variable, defaulting to SHA-1.
